about:
# EasyReminders

World of Warcraft addon to remind you to apply buffs and more.

*Important*: due to the addon restrictions introduced in Midnight this addon cannot display buff reminders in combat, PvP encounters or when a M+ key is active!

#### Buff Reminders
Reminds you to apply missing buffs. 
Pre-populated with raid buffs and selected class buffs

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/03ca3680-34bb-4803-a13f-6daa708409b1)

#### Consumables Reminders
Checks for missing consumable buffs (eg flasks, potions, runes) and will display a reminder if you have the item(s) in your bags.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/aaa4fa7e-3ea7-4729-bdbe-337654b2306f)

#### Food Remidners
Check of a missing "Well Fed" buff and will display if you have selected food items.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/01ef1f5f-0875-4c76-929d-ab2bcc025d86)

#### Gear Reminders
Checks for missing enchants and gems

Checks for missing temporary weapon enhancemts (oils, stones, etc)

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b7b3da13-4373-4a16-9c78-a67c07cd5155)

#### Shopping Reminders
Tracks stackable items in your bags

Alerts you if tracked items fall below your chosen minimum limit

Configurable Alerts on instance exit, item use or login

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/05b18e45-cc3d-4d64-aa9b-908cc6ab1163)

#### Calendar Reminders
Reminds you when major holiday events are active.

Can be paused untill the next day or the next time the event starts.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a8580d59-a185-42d9-a9a0-2b5bf7c1b8b7)

#### Group Calendar Reminders
Reminds you of upcoming group invites

Advanced notice of up to 1 day

Supports Guilds Communities and personal calendar entries

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f04e01f9-e4be-4283-a7a7-ed08b132d541)

#### Configurable
Seperate settings for raid, dungeons, delves and outdoors

#### Customizable
You can add your own buffs, consumables and food

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1a26a1d2-0acd-4dcb-8d0c-00305a0dafbe)

#### How to find spell and item IDs

The easiest way is to use and addon like IdTip, ElvUI or All The Things

(If you use All the Things you cna enable ids in ATT Settings->Interface->Information and then enable "itemID" and "spellID")

Alternatively you can get the ids from Wowhead - just look up then item or spell and it's ID is in the URL!
